Liam H: Hey - joined Redwood today, but my calendar shows the orientation at 02:00 UTC even though the invite text says 9:00 AM PT. Anybody else?
Sofia T: I ran into that too. Outlook sometimes prefers the literal Z (UTC) value if the .ics also includes TZID.
Liam H: The .ics has DTSTART:20260601T160000Z and TZID:America/Los_Angeles. Is that the issue?
Sofia T: Yep. If your calendar client reads the Z timestamp it will show UTC.
Rachael (People Ops): Sorry for the hassle! We schedule in PT. We're going to resend the invite without the trailing Z (DTSTART with TZID only) and add an APAC-friendly repeat. @onboarding-bot can you handle that and attach captioning consent text?
onboarding-bot: Will do  regenerating invites with TZID-only timestamps, creating Friday APAC repeat, and will post recording + captions to onboarding wiki after the session.
Liam H: Great, thanks. Will the recording have captions/transcript? I'm in GMT+1 so I'll likely watch later.
Rachael (People Ops): Yes  recorded session, automated captions, and a short human edit will be uploaded to the onboarding wiki (internal link posted after session). We aim for within 1 hour post-session.
Sofia T: Workaround in the meantime: open the event in Outlook > Time Zones and set it to Pacific Time, or delete and accept the updated invite when it arrives.
Liam H: Deleted the event and will re-accept. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
